newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Sino Land plans convertible bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Sino Land plans convertible bond issue.

text.p: Sino Land Co Ltd said on Thursday it proposed an issue of convertible bonds due 2002 to raise funds for working capital and to finance the purchase and development of properties in Hong Kong.

"It is intended that the net proceeds of the issue of the bonds will be used by the company for its working capital requirements and to finance the acquisition and development of further properties in Hong Kong (including the acquisition of a plot of land in Siu Sai Wan, Chai Wan)," Sino Land said in a statement.
Sino Land said the detailed pricing and other terms of the bonds including the amount to be raised, interest rate and conversion premium had not yet been finalised.

Jardine Fleming International Inc has been appointed to lead manage the bond issue. Applications will be made to list the bonds in Luxemburg, and to list the shares of the company to be issued upon exercise of conversion rights in Hong Kong, it said.
The bonds will be primarily offered to institutional and professional investors in Europe and the United States, and the bonds may also be offered to investors in Hong Kong.
Further details will be announced if the proposed issue of bonds proceeds, it said.
Sino Land and its chairman's family jointly bought the Chai Wan site for HK$11.82 billion at a government land auction last month.
